0022600140.text: The Denver Nuggets (1-2, 4th in the Northwest and 10th in the West) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, 5th in the Southwest and 14th in the West) for the fourth game of Denver's season, with the Nuggets on a one-game losing streak and New Orleans on a three-game skid. Denver will be without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, and New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee bruise). Denver leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 141-135 win in Denver on October 24, and the Nuggets also won all three meetings in 2025-26.
